arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ.
transliteration: Astawdi'ullaaha deenaka, wa amaanataka, wa khawaateema 'amalik.
translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and your final deeds.

arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتَ.
transliteration: Zawwadakallaahut-taqwaa, wa ghafara thanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu maa kunt.
translation: May Allah equip you with piety, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
